heat_pump_specific_notes.masssave.com: 16.6k ETV and owns Massachusetts rebate demand.
heat_pump_specific_notes.heatpumpnetwork.com: Almost no organic traffic yet. Already publishing 2026 rebate-by-state content.
heat_pump_specific_notes.electrifyatlas.com: Almost no organic traffic. Already covering HEEHRA status.
heat_pump_specific_notes.oem_pages: Bryant and Carrier rank with thin 2026 cost guides. Easy to beat on usefulness, harder on brand.
